title: Initial witness selection
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean-valued tapes, let $c,B,e$ be natural numbers, and let $z$ be a Boolean list. If the nested pair encoding formed from the indicated projections of $z$ belongs to the initial language of $N$, return the second projection of the second projection of $z$; otherwise return the empty list.

c, B, and e are natural numbers
